checks_1_to_3_preprocessing_labels_scali.method: Train a classical Logistic Regression on the EXACT same [0, pi]-scaled 4-feature data the VQC receives, using the same train/test split and labels.
checks_1_to_3_preprocessing_labels_scali.conclusion: Signal fully intact after quantum scaling -- rules out a preprocessing, label-encoding, or feature-scaling bug as the cause of VQC underperformance.

check_6_optimizer_convergence.method: Same circuit/data, COBYLA vs SPSA, both maxiter=25, shots=256.
check_6_optimizer_convergence.conclusion: Two structurally different optimizers (direct-search vs stochastic-approximation) converge to similarly poor results -- this argues against 'wrong optimizer' as the root cause and toward a circuit-expressivity / loss-landscape limitation.

check_7_initialization_stability.method: COBYLA (maxiter=60), 5 different random seeds, same circuit structure.
check_7_initialization_stability.conclusion: Consistently poor performance across independent random initializations -- rules out an unlucky single initialization as the primary cause; points toward a structural (circuit / optimizer landscape) limitation rather than initialization chance.

check_8_circuit_depth.method: Same feature map, ansatz reps=1 vs reps=2, same optimizer/seed.
check_8_circuit_depth.conclusion: Increasing ansatz depth did not materially improve performance -- rules out simple under-expressivity (at least within this modest depth range) as the sole cause.

check_4_circuit_construction.method: Static review of feature-map/ansatz composition and parameter counts.
check_4_circuit_construction.conclusion: Circuit composes correctly (feature map then ansatz, 4 qubits, standard ZZFeatureMap + RealAmplitudes structure) -- no construction error found; expressivity is tested separately under check 8.

check_5_measurement_interpretation.method: Inspect the underlying SamplerQNN's interpret function and output shape.
check_5_measurement_interpretation.interpret_function: standard VQC parity-based binary interpretation (Qiskit ML default)
check_5_measurement_interpretation.conclusion: Standard, unmodified Qiskit Machine Learning default parity interpretation for binary VQC classification -- no custom or misconfigured output mapping found.
